item.title: TenZ responds after viral posts accuse Kyedae of cheating clarifies John Choi trip and calls rumors harmful
item.description: TenZ addressed online rumors claiming Kyedae cheated on him with John Choi. He denied the claims, saying John is a shared friend and photos were taken out of context. He also denied donating bone marrow to Kyedae. Later, TenZ said esports helped him ignore online hate. Kyedae has not commented.
item.dc:creator: Sehjal Gupta

item.title: Kelly Refuses To Condemn Owens: Faces backlash over Israel row; cites free speech stance
item.description: Megyn Kelly defended her decision not to condemn Candace Owens despite public pressure over controversial online claims involving Charlie Kirk. Kelly said the demands were political and rooted in Israel-related debates. She stressed about Charlie Kirk theories and that refusing to condemn someone does not mean agreement, adding she will not speak just to satisfy critics.
item.dc:creator: Sehjal Gupta

item.title: Twitch introduces new ads for paused streams, sparks viewer backlash
item.description: Twitch is rolling out "pause-screen ads" starting February 10, 2026, a move met with criticism from viewers and streamers. While intended to boost streamer earnings, users fear these ads will disrupt viewing habits and potentially lead to site abandonment. The platform maintains the ads aim to increase revenue without fully interrupting the stream.
item.dc:creator: Sumit Roy

item.title: “I want to honor God”: Erika Kirk addresses backlash as Bad Bunny’s Super Bowl LX show outshines TPUSA’s halftime show
item.description: Erika Kirk spoke out after Turning Point USA aired its alternative Super Bowl LX halftime show honoring her late husband, Charlie Kirk. The broadcast featured a tribute montage and patriotic performances, claiming millions of viewers despite streaming restrictions. While Bad Bunny headlined the official NFL show, the rival event blended politics, grief, and culture into a deeply emotional night.
item.dc:creator: Barsha Dutta

item.title: US governors cancel White House meeting after Donald Trump didn’t invite Democrats: Report
item.description: The National Governors Association canceled its meeting with President Trump after the White House excluded Democratic governors. This decision undermines federal-state collaboration, as the association emphasizes unity and constructive engagement. The White House's exclusion of key Democratic leaders goes against the NGA's tradition of bipartisan gatherings.

item.title: ‘This is wrong’: Team USA curler speaks out on Minnesota ICE raids during Olympics
item.description: Team USA curler Rich Ruohonen used an Olympic press conference to voice concerns about immigration enforcement actions in his home state of Minnesota. As an attorney, he emphasized his belief that these events infringe upon basic rights and fairness, drawing parallels to constitutional principles. Ruohonen also commended Minnesotans for their compassion during this challenging time.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Mizkif reflects on Maya Higa breakup while discussing JasonTheWeen and Sakura split
item.description: Streamer Mizkif shared his thoughts on the recent breakup of JasonTheWeen and Sakura. He compared their situation to his own past relationship with Maya Higa. Mizkif suggested the split could impact JasonTheWeen's career positively. He also noted Sakura might face a more difficult path. This highlights the complex nature of public streaming relationships and their social dynamics.

item.title: YouTube Music faces backlash after making song lyrics a premium-only feature
item.description: YouTube Music has limited free users' access to song lyrics, allowing only five free lyric views before blurring them. This change, implemented to encourage premium subscriptions, has sparked user dissatisfaction. Listeners now face the choice of upgrading to YouTube Music Premium for $10.99 monthly or using the service with restricted lyric access.
item.dc:creator: Sumit Roy

item.title: First images of Nancy Guthrie kidnapping suspect out: FBI shares chilling photos of ski-masked man tampering with camera
item.description: FBI Director Kash Patel revealed surveillance photos of an armed individual in a ski mask tampering with Nancy Guthrie's home security camera on the morning of her disappearance. These previously inaccessible images, recovered from backend systems, mark the first indication of a possible suspect in the 84-year-old's vanishing act, which has been described as a fruitless investigation.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: UK-India FTA gets compared to ‘bag of soggy poppadums’ in House of Commons debate
item.description: UK MPs across parties criticized the UK-India FTA in the House of Commons, citing concerns over services, National Insurance evasion, delayed tariff reductions for British goods, and a lack of enforceable human rights clauses. Critics warned of cheap imports and the potential impact on British workers, particularly concerning the double contributions convention.
item.dc:creator: NAOMI CANTON

item.title: 'Positive conversation': Carney calls Donald Trump after president threatened to block Gordie Howe International Bridge opening
item.description: Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney spoke with US President Donald Trump regarding the Gordie Howe International Bridge, after Trump threatened to block its opening. Carney clarified that Canada fully funded the bridge, which is jointly owned by Canada and Michigan, despite Trump's claims of insufficient U.S. content.

item.title: Plane with 55 on board crashes after takeoff in Somalia; all survive — watch
item.description: A Fokker 50 aircraft carrying 55 people experienced a technical fault shortly after takeoff from Mogadishu, forcing an emergency landing. The plane overshot the runway and came to rest in shallow water. All passengers and crew were safely evacuated, with the pilot commended for his swift actions.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: 'We are allowed to voice our opinion': Chloe Kim defends fellow Olympian Hunter Hess after Trump calls her 'real loser'
item.description: Olympic snowboarding champion Chloe Kim has defended fellow Team USA athlete Hunter Hess, who faced criticism from President Trump for expressing mixed feelings about representing the US due to the current political climate. Kim, whose parents are immigrants, emphasized unity and pride in representing the nation, stating the issue hits close to home.
